title: Nice full featured coffee maker; much larger and taller than expected
text: Nice full featured coffee maker; much larger and taller than expected. I got this Coffee Maker to replace an older one that lacked two important features that this has:  programming when you want the brewing to start and automatic shutoff.  This also has a nice feature that lets you pour a cup of coffee before it has completed brewing; you have 25 seconds to put the carafe back in before the filter basket overflows.  The machine also shuts off any drips any time you remove the carafe.  My old coffee maker would just drip coffee on to the heating element.  This coffee maker keeps the coffee warm for 2 hours before automatic shutoff.  It would seem to me that for a roughly $100 coffee maker, it should include a feature to set how long you want the coffee kept warm, rather than just a per-determined 2 hour shutoff.  You can always manually turn it off of course or unplug it.  You also can start it manually with a brew button.  If you don't want to use the timer or if you want to override the timer, you can do that with the manual button.  Of course with a built in timer, you have a clock displayed on the control panel, but that's one more thing to set the time on when there is a power failure.  A battery backup for the clock would also have been a nice feature that's not included.  One nice feature that is included is an optional carbon filter inside the tank that makes the coffee taste better.  Also note that this comes with a permanent filter brew basket, negating the need to buy paper coffee filters.  Another feature is a "small batch" button when you are only brewing 2 to 4 cups, but I couldn't see the point of it since it will still brew 12 cups of you fill the coffee maker with 12 cups of water.  Overall it's a nice coffee maker with some good features.  So what's wrong with it?  It's a bit pricey.  It is also very large; a big hulking machine.  My old coffee maker that makes the same 12 cups is only 11 inches high.  This is a whopping 15 1/2 inches tall.  It is also 9 inches wide; my old one is only 6 1/2 inches wide.  Both my old one and this one are 10 inches deep.  Of course a little extra size is needed for the digital control panel.  If you are using this on a counter with cupboards above make sure you have at least a 16 inch clearance as this is the "incredible hulk" of coffee makers.  I knocked one star off my otherwise 5-star rating for the huge size.
